name: ZX_STATUS_B
description: This table stores tax statuses and the related attributes for multiple configuration owners. Each row stores a status for a tax and configuration owner.

columns.name: TAX_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Tax status code

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.description: Effective from date

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_TO
columns.description: Effective to date

columns.name: TAX
columns.description: Tax for this status

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Tax regime code for this status

columns.name: RULE_BASED_RATE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether rules are defined for this status to determine tax rate

columns.name: ALLOW_RATE_OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether the rate for this status can be overridden

columns.name: ALLOW_EXEMPTIONS_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether exemptions are allowed for this tax status

columns.name: ALLOW_EXCEPTIONS_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether exceptions are allowed for this tax status

columns.name: DEFAULT_STATUS_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether this is the default status code for the tax

columns.name: DEFAULT_FLG_EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.description: Effective start date from which this is the default status for the tax

columns.name: DEFAULT_FLG_EFFECTIVE_TO
columns.description: Effective end date till when this is the default status for the tax

columns.name: DEF_REC_SETTLEMENT_OPTION_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether an input tax can be recovered when an invoice is recorded or only when the invoice is paid and whether an output tax is due for settlement when the invoice is issued or only when the payment is received against it.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether the record is migrated, seeded or defined by the user

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.
